statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; let M := fun X : ℕ => Real.sqrt (X:ℝ) / (Real.log (X:ℝ))^2; ∃ c δ : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ 0 < δ ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, δ*(X:ℝ) ≤ (((E X).filter (fun n => c*M X ≤ (H X n:ℝ))).card:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 正比例的偶数拥有许多小步长表示
plain_statement.en: Find a positive proportion of endpoints with many witnesses

brief.zh: 先扣除低于阈值的终点贡献，再对余下终点用柯西不等式。结论允许有正比例的例外。
brief.en: Subtract the contribution below a small threshold and use Cauchy–Schwarz on the rest. Exceptions are still allowed.
